player_behavior: Desktop free-action and story-choice turns consume local-host SSE endpoints and show player-visible narrative_delta text while the model is still generating.
Streaming text is preview-only: the Run is not refreshed or presented as committed until turn_completed and a persisted Run reload succeed.
A turn_failed event becomes the existing retryable failure state; both stream paths commit only after the validated turn reaches the state-application boundary.
not_proven: Android embedded runtime still exposes operation stages but does not yet expose a cross-platform narrative stream callback.
Physical Android, Windows native package and packaged macOS WebView visual acceptance remain unrun.
